import pytest

def test_daterange_year_step_starting_in_december():
    from datetime import date
    from boltons.timeutils import daterange

    start_day = date(year=2012, month=12, day=25)
    end_day = date(year=2023, month=1, day=1)
    dates = list(daterange(start_day, end_day, step=(1, 0, 0), inclusive=False))
    expected = [date(year=year, month=12, day=25) for year in range(2012, 2023)]
    assert dates == expected
